classification: Visible authored-fixture limitations recorded; no new regression classification from these screenshots alone.

fixedAuthoredSvg.binding: The five scenario.props.svg strings exactly equal the matching fixture samples. They remain explicit A/light SVGs when the gallery root changes brand/theme.

areaAuthoredSlot.note: The fixture JSON also contains an area sample, but this shared scenario selects an authored slot and supplies no svg prop.

nativeComponentTheme.measures: Requested root brand/theme, forced-colors media, resolved CSS canvas/text roles, visible component bounds, CSS color/background text pairs, and focus controls. It does not grade SVG mark fill/stroke or SVG canvas-paint conformance.
nativeComponentTheme.specificCaveat: Its text-pair loop reads style.color and CSS background colors even for SVG text; that is not a measurement of declared SVG fill against an SVG rect canvas.

generatedInvoiceUsage.population: 48 chart theme cases across Invoice/Usage, canonical/detail plus dashboard, React/Vue, and six A/B theme scopes.
generatedInvoiceUsage.measures: Creates each requested-scope public SVG, verifies generated SVG byte equality, grades its normalized IR, then mounts the real generated consumer. runVizThemeProof observes SVG fill/stroke/canvas, visible data marks and labels, accessible chart name, and screenshots.
generatedInvoiceUsage.completionCaveat: The current m07 runtime sweep is separately owned and qualified by root; this two-screenshot gallery inspection does not certify its completion.

m07ClaimAssessment.basis: The verification reports count themeRootCells; Increment14 separately describes public HC render support and48 placement theme checks. Those scoped statements do not assert that every authored gallery SVG is recolored or has its SVG paint contrast certified.
m07ClaimAssessment.unsupportedBroaderClaim: An unqualified statement that all109 gallery components have every SVG mark/text paint themed or HC-contrast-certified would exceed the native component proof.
m07ClaimAssessment.qualificationForHandoff: Native gallery theme checks and actual generated chart paint checks are distinct evidence populations; retain that distinction.
